purpose: Select one especially notable item from a larger set.
keywords: とりわけ + highlighted item / quality
This town is especially beautiful in spring.
She is particularly enthusiastic among the participants.
The market stood out especially strongly from the trip.
formation: とりわけ + highlighted item / quality
restrictions: Similar to 特に, often with an explicit comparison set.
mistake: It does not exclude the importance of the other items.
